clips.title: The story
paras: On Shimmer Ridge, Frostmane trolls gather shimmerweed for their rituals. Dwarven brewmaster Rejold Barleybrew wants to test its sharp flavor in his stout.

The Frostmane trolls tend shimmerweed on the icy crags of Shimmer Ridge, high above Dun Morogh's lowlands. They harvest the plant and store it in woven baskets throughout their camps, where it fuels their sacred rituals. Few mountaineers beyond troll society pay the herb much mind, though inventive outsiders have taken an interest.

In Brewnall Village, brewmaster Rejold Barleybrew suspects shimmerweed may be the missing piece in his attempt to brew the ultimate dwarven stout. He has detected the herb's pungent, unmistakable flavor and wants to see what it brings to his fermenting vats. Rejold hires travelers to slip into Frostmane camps, evade the hostile trolls, and bring back bushels.
